description: Show which workspace the connected project belongs to (personal, or a team) and that workspace's wallet balance. Everything run or bought through this connection is charged to this wallet. In a team it also gives the team role calls act with, admin or member. Use it before paid work and when a call is refused for insufficient balance. With recent_transactions it also lists the wallet's latest transactions, the rows the Transactions page of the Wiro dashboard shows, which is how to check that a charge or a credit landed. In a team the wallet is shared, so the list holds the activity of the whole team.

recent_transactions.description: Also list this many of the wallet's latest transactions, newest first (1 to 50). Leave it out to read only the balance.

transactions_start.description: How many of the latest rows to skip, from nextStart in the last answer. Without recent_transactions it lists 20 rows.

name: get_account

amountUsd.description: The amount in USD, always positive; direction gives the sign.

direction.description: Whether the row adds to the wallet or takes from it.

expiresAt.description: For credit that can be spent only for a while: when it ends.

type.description: The row's type as the wallet page names it, such as PAYMENT, PAYMENT (COUPON), DEPOSIT or TRANSFER IN.

transactionsError.description: Why the transactions could not be read, when the balance could.

title: Get Wiro account balance and workspace
